title: Engineering Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Beta is a dynamic, product\-based software company focused on engineering high\-performance digital solutions. The organization designs, builds, and launches a diverse suite of proprietary software products, ranging from intuitive consumer applications to scalable platforms for businesses and large enterprises. Its work centers on simplifying daily routines for individual users and streamlining complex workflows for organizations, always prioritizing immediate value and exceptional user experiences. Guided by technical excellence and human\-centric design, Beta delivers software that is powerful, secure, and accessible. Team members join a culture that values innovation, quality, and practical impact in the digital world.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Engineering Specialist role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Tiruvallur. This role involves supporting manufacturing and mechanical engineering activities, including analyzing production processes, improving system performance, and assisting in the design and implementation of engineering solutions. The Engineering Specialist collaborates with cross\-functional teams to manage projects, track milestones, and ensure technical requirements, safety standards, and quality goals are met. Daily responsibilities include collecting and interpreting data, preparing technical documentation, coordinating with stakeholders, and communicating updates to project teams and leadership. The role also contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing workflows to enhance efficiency and reliability.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills for clear reporting, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement.
* Candidates should possess Analytical Skills for data interpretation, problem\-solving, and process optimization.
* Candidates should possess Project Management skills for planning, coordination, tracking deliverables, and risk management.
* Candidates should possess Manufacturing Engineering skills for production support, process improvement, and quality assurance.
* Candidates should possess Mechanical Engineering skills for design review, system analysis, and technical troubleshooting.
* Relevant technical degree or diploma in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering (or related field).
* Experience in a plant, production, or industrial environment is preferred.
* Working knowledge of engineering tools, CAD software, and basic familiarity with safety and compliance standards.
* Ability to work on\-site in Tiruvallur, manage multiple tasks, and adapt to changing priorities in a fast\-paced setting.

title: Design Manager
description:
**Role Summary**
 Responsible to oversee the preparation, validation, and release of engineering documentation, ensuring alignment with project timelines and manufacturing needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/ Accountabilities**
**Project management**
* Ensure timely planning, tracking, and execution of design documentation tasks to meet order requirements.
* Maintaining Lead time targets, and quality standards.
* Managing relations with the customer leveraging regular updates on requirements.
* Maintaining clear activity logs for visibility and control.
* Managing risks, budgetary constraints, and other stakeholder management.


**Design**
* Track the requirements of pending orders requiring release of design documentation
* Preparation of designs with proper models / layouts and drawings for manufacture
* Checking documents to ensure first time right in design releases
* Release of design documents in line with the metrics for lead time
* Maintain the activity log for the release of design documentation


**MIS**
* Ensure that the periodic reports for MIS are generated \- weekly, monthly and inputs for the review meetings are provided on time every time

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee (GET) - Quality
description:
About the Role
 
 We are looking for a 
 **Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Quality** 
  to join our Quality team in transformer manufacturing. The candidate will be trained and involved in 
 **quality inspection, testing, documentation, process monitoring and quality assurance** 
  throughout the transformer manufacturing process.
 



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for a fresh engineering graduate to build strong practical knowledge in 
 **distribution and power transformers, electrical testing, manufacturing processes and Quality Management Systems (QMS).** 




  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Assist the Quality team in 
 **incoming, in\-process and final inspection** 
  of transformer components and assemblies.
* Support inspection of 
 **core, winding, insulation, tank, accessories and other transformer components** 
  as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Assist in conducting and recording 
 **routine and type tests** 
  as applicable.
* Learn and support transformer testing activities such as:
* Winding Resistance
* Transformer Ratio / Voltage Ratio
* Insulation Resistance
* No\-Load Loss \& Current
* Load Loss \& Impedance
* Dielectric / Applied Voltage Test
* Induced Voltage Test
* Oil\-related tests and other applicable inspections
* Verify manufacturing activities against 
 **approved drawings, specifications, work instructions and quality standards** 
 .
* Maintain accurate 
 **inspection reports, test reports, checklists and quality records** 
 .
* Assist in identifying 
 **non\-conformities, defects and process deviations** 
  and support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with 
 **Production, Design, Purchase and Stores** 
  teams for resolution of quality\-related issues.
* Support preparation of 
 **NCR, CAPA and corrective/preventive action records** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining and implementing the company's 
 **ISO 9001 Quality Management System** 
 .
* Participate in internal quality audits, process audits and customer inspections.
* Ensure proper calibration and identification of 
 **measuring and testing instruments** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining quality documentation and records as per QMS requirements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to reduce 
 **rework, rejection and manufacturing defects** 
 .
* Follow all applicable 
 **safety, quality and manufacturing procedures** 
 .



  




 Technical Exposure
 
 The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:
 


* Distribution \& Power Transformers
* Transformer manufacturing processes
* Electrical \& mechanical inspection
* Transformer testing procedures
* Quality Control \& Quality Assurance
* **IS 1180, IS 2026 and IEC 60076**
* **Electrical drawings and specifications**
* **ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System**
* **NCR, CAPA and Root Cause Analysis**
* **Calibration and measuring instruments**
* **Customer and third\-party inspections**



  




 Candidate Profile
 * **Qualification:** 
  B.E./B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering / Electrical Engineering
* **Experience:** 
  Freshers / 0–1 year experience
* Strong interest in 
 **Quality, Testing and Manufacturing**
* **Basic knowledge of electrical engineering concepts**
* **Ability to understand technical drawings and specifications**
* **Good analytical and problem\-solving skills**
* **Good communication and documentation skills**
* **Willingness to work on the shop floor and testing areas**
* **Positive attitude with a strong willingness to learn**



**﻿**



 What We Offer
 * Hands\-on training in 
 **transformer manufacturing and testing**
* **Exposure to industry standards and quality systems**
* **Opportunity to work with experienced Quality, Design and Production teams**
* **Practical exposure to customer and third\-party inspections**
* **Career growth opportunities in Quality Assurance, Quality Control and Testing**
* **Ideal for:** 
  Fresh engineering graduates who want to build a career in 
 **Transformer Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Electrical Testing and Industrial Quality Management.**

title: Senior Content Writer
description:
**Position Summary:** 
 The role of a senior content writer is to develop compelling written and digital content that communicates our services, capabilities and brand voice. The person in this role will plan, research, draft, revise, and help produce communications across multiple platforms. In addition to managing the firm’s website content, the person will develop copy for printed or electronic collateral, social media, and other channels as needed. Experience with website user experience, SEO principles, and keyword research will be a major advantage.
   

  

 As a senior content writer, you bring a passion for transforming raw ideas into clear, persuasive communication. You are able to distill raw data into a coherent story, and you understand the power of crafting a message for its intended audience. When additional information must be gathered, you are comfortable interviewing executives and technical staff. You bring energy and enthusiasm to your work, along with the ability to develop positive, cooperative relationships both inside and outside the marketing department. As a senior writer, you influence content priorities and collaborate with leadership to ensure messaging aligns with the firm’s broader objectives. You also offer support to other writers on the team and engage in cross\-functional efforts as requested. You are well organized and able to juggle multiple assignments at once, meeting deadlines and keeping others informed of your progress or roadblocks. Finally, you are a problem\-solver, able to identify and implement solutions to a wide variety of challenges, both technical and interpersonal, to meet the goals of the marketing department and the firm.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 ▪ Develop a working knowledge of the firm’s practice areas, service offerings, markets, professional staff, industry experience, methodologies and key service differentiators in order to create content for multiple media channels
   

  

 ▪ Understand the principles of persuasive and informative communication, including the use of varying styles for different purposes or audiences
   

  

 ▪ Strategize and recommend appropriate communications to achieve the marketing goals of various stakeholders, industry niches or service lines
   

  

 ▪ Develop internal content for executive communication efforts, including copy for announcements related to new partners/directors and practice\-specific updates
   

  

 ▪ Support external communication initiatives, including press release development and executive quotes, as well as content writing for external media opportunities
   

  

 ▪ Research, draft and revise written and/or visual content for blogs, collateral, websites, presentations and other uses as requested
   

  

 ▪ Edit and proofread content drafts from internal or external sources to make it suitable for the desired use, including familiarity with AI platforms and its strategic use for content development
   

  

 ▪ Format content by taking an editorial approach that follows best practices for structural/developmental editing or copy editing, as deemed appropriate for the firm’s website or media channels
   

  

 ▪ Proofread written materials as requested to ensure grammatical correctness, effectiveness and conformance with brand standards and style
   

  

 ▪ Maintain a working knowledge of AP Style and its evolving guidelines, and apply it to Weaver’s style sheet as appropriate
   

  

 ▪ Collaborate with team members to ensure content development efforts align with marketing plan initiatives and goals
   

  

 ▪ Assist with ongoing maintenance and engagement with project management tools, including Monday.com and the content library
   

  

 ▪ Adhere to the firm’s policies, procedures and core values, demonstrating their importance to others
   

  

 ▪ Perform other duties as assigned
   

  

**Corporate Compliance Responsibilities**
 Understands and adheres to the policies, procedures and compliance standards set forth by Weaver and Tidwell, L.L.P. Ensures that he/she is trained and evaluated on the knowledge of and adherence to compliance policies and procedures specific to the job.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions unless it would cause an undue hardship. Regardless of accommodations offered, the employee or potential employee is responsible for being able to perform the essential duties of the position.
   

  

 ▪ Bachelor’s degree in English, marketing, communications, technical writing or related discipline
   

  

 ▪ 5\-7 years of writing or marketing communications experience, preferably with a professional services firm
   

  

 ▪ Experience with supporting other writers on the team and cultivating their talent to meet team goals
   

  

 ▪ Excellent writing skills with demonstrated ability to create original content and edit the work of others to meet different needs
   

  

 ▪ Familiarity with various AI platforms and ability to develop effect prompts for clear, accurate outputs
   

  

 ▪ Ability to synthesize large amounts of information to extract the key message(s)
   

  

 ▪ Impeccable proofreading ability; familiarity with AP Style
   

  

 ▪ Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines
   

  

 ▪ Ability to work and interact effectively with partners, directors and manager stakeholders, as well as marketing teammates
   

  

 ▪ Independence and the ability to operate without direction in areas of uncertainty and ambiguity, while remaining in close communication with teammates and stakeholders
   

  

 ▪ Commitment to maintaining and continuously improving knowledge of the firm and its service offerings, as well as best practices in communications
   

  

 ▪ Excellent verbal, interpersonal, presentation and public\-speaking communication skills
   

  

 ▪ Proficiency with Microsoft applications (Word, PowerPoint, Copilot)
   

  

 ▪ Ability to use excellent judgment, handle confidential information appropriately and display a professional demeanor
   

  

 ▪ Must be able to sit for extended periods of time and work with exposure to noise at various levels typical of an office environment
   

  

 ▪ Ability to type on a keyboard and look at computer screen for eight hours or more per day
   

  

 ▪ Overtime may be required
   

  

 ▪ Ability to lift approximately 5 pounds on a regular basis and up to 25 pounds on an infrequent basis
   

  

 ▪ Minimal travel required, primarily between firm offices

title: Assistant Manager - Application Engineering
description:
The Application Engineer is responsible to Lead engineering projects in support of Chain drive timing systems \& Variable Cam timing systems product development including FORD I6 Timing Drive
   

  

* Knowledge and understanding of Gasoline Ignition \& Diesel Combustion systems and performance.
* Work with customers to understand their Valve timing strategy and in turn select the appropriate products from the book shelf
* Creation or review of product performance specifications or targets.
* Design of product to meet specification and packaging constraints.
* Proof of concept evaluation and technical assessment of design refinements with the analytical calculation, stack ups,
* Recommend application specific design changes that meet customer’s technical requirements.
* Lead or support DFMEA and DVP\&R reviews with customers .
* Support analysis of prototype parts for functional performance and/or failure modes as well as parts diagnostics on customer vehicles/engines.
* Lead or support all technical meetings with customers / suppliers and with appropriate cross functional team
* Knowledge \& use of problem solving techniques for failure investigation and root cause analysis – 8D, FTA, Six sigma etc
* Release design for various program phases in conformance with product design guidelines and Product Development Processes.
* Identify new concepts that address weaknesses within our current product portfolio or technology roadmap.
* Plant product support for improved quality, manufacturing efficiency or design cost reductions.
* Should be able to work and co\-ordinate for a project with multinational working group.
* Should be competent in ISO 50001 2011 requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining and improving an energy management system and follow a systematic approach in achieving continual improvement of energy performance, including energy efficiency, energy use and consumption

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Verantwortung für die globale Projektsteuerungsaktivität und Förderung einheitlicher Funktionsspezifikationen und gemeinsamer globaler Prozesse für die Projektimplementierung. Tätigkeiten, die dazu dienen, die Erwartungen des Kunden besser zu verstehen oder letztendlich zu erfüllen Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und \-verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Bietet technisches Know\-how und entwickelt technische Lösungen (Konfiguration, Leistungsschätzung, Wirtschaftlichkeit usw.) im Rahmen des Pre\-ITO\-Prozesses (Beschaffung), und fungiert gleichzeitig als Schnittstelle zum kaufmännischen Team. Verfügt über fundiertes Wissen über die relevanten Märkte und des wirtschaftlichen Werts der Kunden, was zur Gewinnung von Gebotsstrategien beiträgt. Einschließen von "ITO": Technische Analyse des Kundenbedarfs: Definition und Optimierung der Produkte; Umfang (Beschreibung); Zeitplan; industrielle Regelung; Kosten unter Berücksichtigung der vertraglichen und internen Richtlinien und Verfahren. Berechnung der Leistung und Effizienz von Anlagen, Systemen und Ausrüstung. Dokumentation von technischen Spezifikationen und Kalkulationselementen für weitere Phasen der Vertragsabwicklung. Dazu gehört auch der OTR\-Teil, in dem die Ingenieure daran arbeiten, die Produkte anzupassen und für bestimmte Kundenanforderungen umzusetzen
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Lead Engineer-Systems Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
   

  

 Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous\-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
* Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.
